name: 3d-wooden-modeler-ci
description: CI-only manifest. The app itself is a single self-contained index.html with no build step. This file exists only so GitHub Actions can install JSON-schema validation tooling.

scripts.validate:schemas: for f in examples/*.woodmodel.json; do ajv validate --spec=draft7 --strict=false -c ajv-formats -s woodmodel.schema.json -d "$f"; done && for f in examples/*.woodtemplates.json; do ajv validate --spec=draft7 --strict=false -c ajv-formats -s woodtemplates.schema.json -d "$f"; done
